law_name: Law No. 2014-038 on the Protection of Personal Data
jurisdiction: Malagasy Commission for Informatics and Liberties (CMIL)
scope: Data subjects whose personal data is processed (unconfirmed)
applies_to: Public and private controllers processing personal data (unconfirmed)
key_requirements: Consent or other legal basis; prior notification to the CMIL before processing; cross-border transfers only to countries with adequate protection or with CMIL approval (unconfirmed)
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data (biometric and health among them) (unconfirmed)
enforcement_authority: Malagasy Commission for Informatics and Liberties (CMIL)
penalties_range: Vendor source cites up to 5% of pre-tax turnover plus criminal penalties; not verified against the statute (unconfirmed)
exemptions: Journalistic; artistic and academic research processing under safeguards (secondary summary; articles not found) (unconfirmed)
notes: Enforcement long delayed: CMIL structure set by Decree 2023-1541 of 6 Dec 2023; members appointed after Council of Ministers of 30 Jul 2025. Publication date disputed (9 Jun 2015 vs 20 July). Madagascar ratified the Malabo Convention by Law 2024-004.
